versions.changelog: Adds balanced, codec-aware keeper ranking with review risk explanations, preserves engagement data, and adds review-only duplicate image cleanup. Restores metadata-first video deletion through Cove's normal records-only or permanent file-removal flow, removes .dedup-trash creation, protects archive entries, and keeps long-running deletion progress visually stable.

Initial registry release: find duplicates by exact fingerprint, pHash distance, title, or remote ID; persist controls and result filters in shareable URLs; compare videos with authenticated, resilient FFmpeg playback; configure missing or conflicting metadata transfer; refresh Cove authentication in place during long jobs; process metadata copying and deletion independently per video; preserve unresolved videos; reconcile ambiguous deletion responses; and report exact progress and partial results.

name: Duplicate Manager
description: Safe, explainable duplicate review and cleanup for Cove videos and images.
author: jiwenji
